v.1: By the sun and her forenoon splendour,
v.2: by the moon when he follows her,
v.3: by the day when it reveals her,
v.4: by the night when it covers her,
v.5: by the sky and Him who built it,
v.6: by the earth and Him who spread it,
v.7: by the soul and Him who fashioned it,
v.8: and inspired it with [discernment between] its virtues and vices:
v.9: one who purifies it is felicitous,
v.10: and one who betrays it fails.
v.11: The [people of] Thamud denied [Allah’s signs] out of their rebellion,
v.12: when the most wretched of them rose up.
v.13: The apostle of Allah had told them, ‘This is Allah’s she-camel, let her drink!’
v.14: But they impugned him and hamstrung her. So their Lord took them unawares by night because of their sin, and levelled it.
v.15: And He does not fear its outcome.
